item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 08/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With Tropical Cyclone Yagi moving into inland areas of the northern part of Vietnam and weaken gradually, showers will ease off gradually over the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. The weather will improve. Meanwhile, a broad area of low pressure will affect the seas east of Taiwan. Winds will be weak over the coast of Guangdong early to midweek this week, and a broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea.
